سَلْيَآءُ A ewe, or she-goat, (S, K,) and a she-camel, (S,) whose secundine (سَلَاهَا) has become disrupted [in her belly]. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And A ewe, or she-goat, [or she-camel,] whose secundine (سَلَاهَا) has been pulled out or off, or removed from its place. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
